title: eludite/build/start
description: Start a build of the open solution, or of one of its projects, out of process: `dotnet build` (or `dotnet clean`) for SDK-style solutions, the located MSBuild (Mono's, or Build Tools' on Windows) when the solution has legacy (non-SDK) projects. The host answers at once; the build streams eludite/build/output and eludite/build/progress and ends with exactly one eludite/build/finished. One build at a time per host: a second start while one runs fails with -32010 (BuildInProgress).

target.description: build: an incremental build (restore included). rebuild: clean, then build. clean: delete the outputs.

project.description: Absolute path of one project file of the open solution to build alone (with its project references). Omitted: the whole solution.

configuration.description: The solution configuration, for example Debug or Release. Omitted: Debug.

platform.description: The solution platform as the solution file lists it, for example Any CPU or x64. Omitted: the solution's default.

buildId.description: The build's id, unique within one host process, from 1.

generation.description: The solution generation the build runs under. A new generation (another solution opened, or this one closed) cancels the build.

path.description: Absolute path of the solution or project file being built.

target.description: build: an incremental build (restore included). rebuild: clean, then build. clean: delete the outputs.

binlog.description: Where the binary log (-bl) is written; null when the toolchain cannot write one.

commandLine.description: The command line run, for the Output window and the log.

kind.description: dotnet: the .NET SDK's `dotnet build`. mono: Mono's MSBuild (located, brief 0003). buildTools: MSBuild.exe from Visual Studio Build Tools (located with vswhere, Windows).

path.description: The MSBuild or dotnet executable or assembly used.

source.description: How it was located (PATH, ELUDITE_MONO_PREFIX, vswhere, ...).
